title: When service needs its center back in the day as it is
issueStatement: The work may still be happening, but the heart has started bargaining with it. The pressure is not abstract anymore; it is meeting the ordinary shape of the day.
centralInsight: Guru joins service to humility, honest labor, and offering rather than display. Gurbani refuses to treat the ordinary day as spiritually irrelevant.
practicalReflection: Seva becomes transformative when the self stops trying to be seen through it. Do one hidden act of service that does not return to self-advertisement.
actionPrompt: Do one hidden act of service that does not return to self-advertisement. Keep the response small enough to survive an ordinary day.
